description:
Requires the company to be enabled for unit of measure (UOM), either a single unit of measure per item, or multiple units of measure. However, in order to support both single or multiple units per item of measure enablement, you must prefix all UOM set names with “By the”, for example, “By the Barrel”. Otherwise, the UOM set won’t show up in the QuickBooks UI in single UOM per item mode.

The `unit_of_measure_set_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account
